sqlEditorFontSize.description: Font size for SQL editor in points

gridShowMultilineText.description: Allow multiline text display in data grid cells (0=off, 1=on)

exportSeparator.description: Field delimiter when exporting data to CSV

exportQuote.description: Text qualifier when exporting data to CSV

exportEscape.description: Escape character for embedded quotes in exported text

autoSaveInterval.description: Interval (seconds) between auto-saves of SQL statements

lastDatabase.description: Path of last opened database (empty if none)

databaseHistory.description: List of recently accessed database paths (up to 10 entries)
